items.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
items.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: Elon Musk says: ‘I’m not MAGA’
items.summary: During his appearance Wednesday at the Dealbook Summit conference, Elon Musk said that he wasn't sure what the term "MAGA" meant and also commented that he felt "pretty foolish" for having spent so much money during the U.S. midterms.
items.creator: Lucas Ropek
